jules: Quick report from morning run of aurora-7b-int4 on GTN slices. Link: s3://internal/aurora7b/2026-03-22/brief.json. Savings ~49% token compute vs int6; median latency 125ms -> 88ms; p95 510ms -> 350ms. Overall QA EM 0.914 -> 0.900 (drop 1.5 pts). Long multi-doc slices (>2500 tokens) show a larger EM drop ~5.1 pts and occasional hallucination duplicates. Need short ops + product recs.

omar: can we do a minimal canary with shadows and a length-based fallback? suggest 4% canary and sticky routing for warmed sessions. Also add a saliency probe for multi-doc (entity count >7) to reroute.

rina: on quant experiments, propose two shadows: (A) per-layer outlier-clip + 8-bit compensator (+7% cost), (B) mixed-precision keep first+last 2 layers int6 (+11% cost). Run both during canary. If B recovers >75% EM with cost <12% recommend promote to 30%.

ops-bot: Canary queued: aurora-7b-int4 @4% traffic with shadow to aurora-7b-int6. Experiments A and B attached. Monitors: gtn_em, hallucination_rate, latency_p95, token_entropy. Alerts: em_delta >=1.0pt on critical slices.

jules: will add 3 redacted failing prompts to ticket infra/eng-ml#1600. Product ok to proceed with 48h canary. Keep slack updates short; post full results in ticket. (reactions: :thumbsup:)
